summary: This directory provides utilities for parsing and transforming HTML elements into structured data formats, specifically focusing on table data extraction and document element normalization to facilitate easier consumption of web-scraped content.
responsibilities: Transforming HTML table elements into structured programmatic objects
Normalizing web content into queryable document representations
Serializing data arrays into HTML table string formats
Providing configurable parsing logic for generic DOM elements
relationships: The scraping utilities consume DOM structures to extract and normalize data into structured table formats.
Configuration options dictate how parsing functions transform raw HTML elements into consistent domain objects.
Table conversion logic maps internal data structures to HTML representations for document generation.
designDecisions: Use of type-safe interfaces to define parsing and generation options
Functional approach for transforming generic HTML elements into structured models
Separation of document navigation logic from data extraction logic
Encapsulation of transformation routines to standardize web scraping output
